about: Campaign Mode's map, staff and stakeholders (docs/CAMPAIGN-MODE.md sections 8, 10 and 12). The test build runs in Queens. Weight is the share of the vote; mayor is Papa-Dani's starting rating there. Every person is invented. Every person has an age and a one-line vibe, and a portrait at public/cast/campaign-<id>.webp (owner, Nov 4: a diverse cast: races, ages, personality types). Owner, Nov 4 ("the mayor role is for the whole city"): Queens is the swing borough. Its places are where you campaign; the other four boroughs (weights are their share of the city's vote, Queens 0.27) start mostly decided, with a lean per candidate, and only citywide moves (ads, TV, the debate, scandals) reach them, at half strength.

staff.name: Sol Brennan
staff.job: Runs the office so you can run the campaign
staff.vibe: Unflappable. Has run nine campaigns, won four, and remembers every one of them.

staff.name: Priya Raman
staff.job: Reads the polls and the room
staff.vibe: Brilliant and a little anxious. Talks in percentages, sleeps in spreadsheets.

staff.name: Theo Marchetti
staff.vibe: Smooth as a press release. Has never once been off his phone.

staff.name: Marisol Vega
staff.vibe: Fearless. Knows every building super in Queens by name, and they all owe her.

stakeholders.name: Inês Ferreira
stakeholders.vibe: Forty years of rent strikes. She will outlast your landlord and you.

stakeholders.name: Stavros Kallas
stakeholders.vibe: Warm, generous, suspicious of anyone who has never worked a counter.

stakeholders.name: Harlan Pryce
stakeholders.vibe: Smiles like a brochure. Every favor comes with a floor plan.

stakeholders.name: Deb Okonkwo
stakeholders.vibe: Tough, fair and impossible to bluff. Her members vote together.

stakeholders.name: Dean Samir Haddad
stakeholders.vibe: Dry wit, bow ties, strong views on student housing.

stakeholders.name: Dez Navarro
stakeholders.vibe: Knows everyone who's anyone after midnight. Can fill a room in an hour.

stakeholders.name: Marguerite Lin
stakeholders.vibe: Relentless. Never forgets a quote, especially the ones you wish you hadn't said.

stakeholders.name: Pastor Ellis Grant
stakeholders.vibe: A booming voice and a bigger heart. His Sunday sermon moves votes.

stakeholders.name: Barry Vance
stakeholders.role: Vance Ribbon & Scissor Co., the Mayor's top donor
stakeholders.vibe: Made a fortune cutting ribbons. Would like to keep cutting them.

stakeholders.name: Auntie Joy Asante
stakeholders.role: Jamaica Block Association, endorses the Mayor
stakeholders.vibe: Everyone's Auntie. Runs the block, the cookout and the endorsement.

stakeholders.name: Lionel Chu
stakeholders.role: Flushing Merchants' Guild, endorses the Mayor
stakeholders.vibe: Polished and careful. Never says yes until he's counted the votes.
